panel.source: blind sibling substrate (iter_5/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_2), manifest opened at the registered 04:31Z
panel.composition: 6 never-seen Hub checkpoints (pythia-410m, EXAONE-4.0-1.2B, Pleias-1.2b-Preview, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B-PT, bloomz-560m, gemma-3-270m-it) + 6 in-house edits of one ERNIE-0.3B parent (a05, a10, fp16, int8wo, resave, wu_nonref)
panel.intersection_with_screen_panel: EMPTY (20 screen repos vs 12 confirmation repos, asserted in results/confirmation.json)
panel.outcome_columns: PRIMARY OR = OR-Bench hard-benign probes (n=43, spread 0.163-0.628); SECONDARY = sealed 54-scenario XSTest split (n=54, spread 0.056-0.333); HC = 85 harmful items
panel.coverage: Tier A + BL1 on all 12; Tier B (W1-W8, A1_prior, A2) on the 6 Hub rows only (the 6 in-house ERNIE arms cannot be rebuilt: no Hub repo); AMS sigma on the 4-6 rows with our own 27-file harvest

registered_verdict.clause_ii: FAILED for every one of the 11 frozen survivors: no paired checkpoint-bootstrap CI on |rho| - |rho_BL1_easy| excludes zero, and no partial rho given BL1_easy and AMS excludes zero.
registered_verdict.note: the registered bar is a MARGIN over the incumbents, not a bare correlation; at n=12 (MDE 0.73) the margin CIs are wide

headline_claims.claim: On 12 never-seen checkpoints the cheap self-fitted ACTIVATION readouts predict over-refusal and the final-layer LOGIT GAP does not: |rho| = 0.94 (W3, n=6), 0.82 (G4), 0.68 (the difference-in-means floor), 0.67 (G3) versus 0.15 for BL1_easy. Both G4 (n=12) and W3 (n=6) exceed their own MDE.
headline_claims.caveat: the registered selection bar is a MARGIN over BL1_easy with a paired CI excluding zero; at this n it does not, so this is reported as a point-estimate result, not a pass.

headline_claims.claim: The mandatory difference-in-means FLOOR already reaches -0.683, so G4's advantage over the floor (-0.815) is small; the large, reproducible gap is between ANY self-fitted activation readout and the logit gap / AMS sigma, not between our new second-order candidates and the field's simplest baseline.
headline_claims.caveat: field norm D: the floor was computed inside the same cross-fitted pipeline, at the same band and site.

headline_claims.claim: EVERY SIGN IS OPPOSITE TO THE REGISTERED EXPECTATION: G3, G4, W3, W5 and W1 correlate NEGATIVELY with over-refusal and POSITIVELY with harmful compliance (G3 +0.77, G4 +0.64, W3 +0.75 on HC). These readouts locate where a checkpoint sits on the refusal/permissiveness trade-off; they do not measure 'more safety'.
headline_claims.caveat: expected signs were registered in the prereg (d_candidates.expected_sign) and are reported beside the observed ones.

headline_claims.claim: AMS Tier-1 sigma (the released incumbent) correlates +0.657 with over-refusal on the 6-row subset where it is computable - the OPPOSITE sign to every activation candidate, which is a substantive disagreement between the two incumbent classes rather than noise about zero.
headline_claims.caveat: n=6, MDE 0.92; AMS needs A_ams (raw-text prompts) which the substrate did not save, so only rows with our own harvest have it.

headline_claims.claim: Reported sensitivity (NOT a registered pass): under a LINEAGE-cluster bootstrap (7 lineages, which is the honest unit count) G4's margin over BL1_easy is +0.663 CI [+0.096, +0.813] and W3's is +0.914 CI [+0.227, +0.943] - both exclude zero, while the registered checkpoint bootstrap gives CIs that include zero. We do not convert this into a pass: the frozen rule is the checkpoint bootstrap, and this sensitivity was computed after the freeze.
headline_claims.caveat: see results/confirm_cluster_sensitivity.json; also reported there is the non-degenerate-readout subset that drops pythia-410m and Pleias-1.2b, whose tiny harmful-vs-benign separation inflates the W-family normaliser.

headline_claims.claim: W2 (redundancy depth) is NaN on the confirmation panel: every held-out row censors (no k in 1..5 halves the readout gap), so the candidate that won the specificity audit cannot be scored on held-out over-refusal at all.
headline_claims.caveat: censoring code 7 / NaN, reported not imputed.
